dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: Hello, are you also coming for work here at the Yashiro Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: If you are here on business concerning the Irodori Festival, please speak to our staff who are present at the event site in Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: Hello, are you also coming for work here at the Yashiro Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: I'm a staff member at the Yae Publishing House. I'm here to give a budget report.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: I'm not certain if it is because of slumps in other industries, but there are more and more new authors sending their work to Yae Publishing House...

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: Well, it's a good thing that the publishing industry is booming, but my work is getting busier.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: If this keeps on going, I won't even have time to visit the Kamisato Clan to chitchat with people...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your job like?

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: My job... it's generally to monitor the content and sales of newly published books each month.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: Don't assume that it's some easy job. I need to gather various data and come up with operation recommendations for Yae Publishing House's publishing strategy...

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: But our boss doesn't seem to care about these things. Regardless of the profits, the boss only cares about doing things her way...

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: I guess that's just the confidence she has as the Lady Guuji...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chitchat?

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: Well, when I come to the Kamisato Clan to meet someone or work, I will take some time to chat with people. It's a good idea to do some networking, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: So I will sometimes hear about stories in the Kamisato Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: I've heard that Thoma gets nervous whenever he sees the Commissioner, and that's because the Commissioner often ropes him in into eating some strange stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: I really didn't expect the efficient and resolute Commissioner to have such a side to him...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: Yeah, I should probably get back to work as well...
